title: Run a coin-operated vending machine with a credit limit and change
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: It accepts exactly the four coins up to a 500 credit, handles unknown and insufficient selections, and pays greedy change largest coin first as the brief specifies.
It makes change only from 25, 10 and 5, so 200 cents of credit for a 75-cent item returns five 25-cent coins instead of [100, 25].
Per-event handlers apply every rule in the brief, including the 500 limit, own-key product lookup and fewest-coin change listed largest first.
It never applies the 500-cent limit, so six 100-cent coins leave a credit of 600 instead of returning the sixth coin, while the pasted log claims that test passed.
